--- title: "In-class Exercise 7: Geography of Accessibility: catchment methods" author: "Dr. Kam Tin Seong
Assoc. Professor of Information Systems(Practice)" institute: "School of Computing and Information Systems,
Singapore Management University" date: today format: revealjs: html: default width: 1600 height: 900 show-notes: false slide-number: true show-slide-number: all execute: eval: true echo: true warning: false freeze: true editor: visual --- ## Loading R package ### Installing **catchment** R package from github Use the code chunk below to install catchment R package from github. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment') ``` ::: Next, load sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility and catchment R packages into RStudio environment using the code chunk below ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment) ``` ::: ## Importing geospatial data Use the code chunk below to import the three geospatial data: MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL, hexagons and ELDERCARE ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>% st_transform(crs = 3414) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons") %>% st_transform(crs = 3414) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE") %>% st_transform(crs = 3414) ``` ::: Next, use the code chunk below to import OD_Matrix.csv into RStudio environment. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0) ``` ::: ## Geospatial Preparation Use the code chunk below to create a new field called *capacity* in *eldercare* sf data frame and populate **100** in it. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} eldercare <- eldercare %>% select(fid) %>% mutate(capacity = 100) ``` ::: Use the code chunk below to create a new field called *demand* in *hexagons* sf data frame and populate value **100** in it. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hexagons <- hexagons %>% select(fid) %>% mutate(demand = 100) %>% rename(id = fid) ``` ::: Use the code chunk the select origin_id, destination_id and total_cost from ODMatrix data frame. Then, rename them to from_id, to_id and dist respectively. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>% select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>% rename(from_id = origin_id, to_id = destination_id, dist = total_cost) ``` ::: ## Computing Minimum Travel Distace to nearest oldercare In the code chunk below, `cost_to_closest()` of **accessibility** package is used to calculates the minimum travel distance to the closest n number (i.e. n=1) of opportunities. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dist2closest <- cost_to_closest( travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied, land_use_data = hexagons, opportunity = "demand", travel_cost = "dist", n = 1, group_by = character(0), active = TRUE, fill_missing_ids = TRUE ) ``` ::: --- ### Joining output Use the code chunk below to append the computed closest distance values to *hexagons* sf data frame. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_acc <- hexagons %>% left_join(dist2closest) %>% rename(dist2closest = dist) ``` ::: --- ### Mapping closest distance ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk Code chunk below will be used to prepare a chotolepth map showing the distribution of closest values in *dist* field. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc) tm_shape(hex_acc, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: ::: ## Converting ODMatrix data frame in a matrix In the code chunk below as.matrix() is used to convert ODMatrix data frame into a Mamtrix object. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} distmat <- ODMatrix %>% select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>% spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>% select(c(-c('origin_id'))) distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000) ``` ::: ## Two-Step Floating Catchment Area In this code chunk below, `[catchment_ratio()](https://uva-bi-sdad.github.io/catchment/reference/catchment_ratio.html)` of catchment package is used to compute 2SFCA. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio( consumers = hexagons$demand, providers = eldercare$capacity, cost = distmat_km, max_cost = 5) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("2SFCA" = ".") ``` ::: --- ### Mapping 2SFCA ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca) tm_shape(hex_2SFCA, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: ::: ## Enhanced 2-Step Floating Catchment Area (E2SFCA) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1)) df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio( consumers = hexagons$demand, providers = eldercare$capacity, cost = distmat_km, weight = step_weights) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("E2SFCA" = ".") ``` ::: --- ### Mapping E2SFCA ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca) tm_shape(hex_E2SFCA, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: ::: ## Kernel Density (Gaussian) 2-Step Floating Catchment Area ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_kd2sfca <- catchment_ratio( consumers = hexagons$demand, providers = eldercare$capacity, cost = distmat_km, weight = "gaussian") %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("KD2SFCA" = ".") ``` ::: --- ### Mapping KD2SFCA ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-22-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_KD2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_kd2sfca) tm_shape(hex_KD2SFCA, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "KD2SFCA", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("KDSFCA Accessibility measures") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: ::: ## 3-Step Floating Catchment Area ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio( consumers = hexagons$demand, providers = eldercare$capacity, cost = distmat_km, step_weights, normalize_weight = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("3SFCA" = ".") ``` ::: --- ### Mapping 3SFCA ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-25-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_3SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_3sfca) tm_shape(hex_3SFCA, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "3SFCA", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("3SFCA Accessibility measures") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: ::: ## Modified 2-Step Floating Catchment Area ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_m2sfca <- catchment_ratio( consumers = hexagons$demand, providers = eldercare$capacity, cost = distmat_km, step_weights, adjust_providers = function(w) w^2) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("M2SFCA" = ".") ``` ::: --- ### Mapping M2SFCA ::: {.panel-tabset} ### The plot ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](In-class_Ex07-accessibility_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-28-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ### The code chunk ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} hex_M2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_m2sfca) tm_shape(hex_M2SFCA, bbox = mapex) + tm_polygons(fill = "M2SFCA", fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( style = "quantile", n = 10, values = "-brewer.blues")) + tm_shape(eldercare) + tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") + tm_title("M2SFCA Accessibility measures") + tm_layout(frame = TRUE) + tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) + tm_scalebar() + tm_grid(alpha = 0.2) ``` ::: :::

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
